title: Pure Entity
summary: Lovecraftian Entity multi-Extra-Deck build combining Elder Entity (Fusion), Old Entity (Synchro), and Outer Entity (Xyz) with their lore Spells and Traps—Forbidden Trapezohedron, Dreamland, and Forbidden Apocrypha—plus Level 2/4 Synchro and Xyz starters. Assembling any two of Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz on the field unlocks Contact Fusion into Elder Entity N'tss or Forbidden Trapezohedron to cheat out the missing third Entity type.

summary.title: Starters
points: Deep Sea Diva Special Summons Guitar Gurnards Duonigis from the Deck on Normal Summon to immediately Synchro Summon Level 4 Old Entity Hastorr or Old Entity Cthugua.

Red Resonator Special Summons a Level 4 or lower monster from the hand on Normal Summon, while Assault Synchron Special Summons itself from the hand as a Level 2 Tuner without using your Normal Summon.
Photon Thrasher and Kagetokage provide free Level 4 bodies to Xyz Summon Rank 4 Outer Entity Nyarla, and Instant Fusion (Limited) summons Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp directly from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Deep Sea Diva + Instant Fusion (or Level 4 Extender)
steps: Normal Summon Deep Sea Diva to Special Summon Guitar Gurnards Duonigis from the Deck, banishing cards from the opponent's Deck, then Synchro Summon Level 4 Old Entity Cthugua.
Activate Instant Fusion to Special Summon Level 4 Mudragon of the Swamp (or summon two Level 4 extenders like Photon Thrasher and Kagetokage to make Outer Entity Nyarla).

With a Synchro (Cthugua) and a Fusion (Mudragon) on the field, activate Forbidden Trapezohedron to Special Summon Rank 4 Outer Entity Nyarla from the Extra Deck and attach Trapezohedron as material—or overlay Cthugua and Mudragon directly into Nyarla to draw 1 card off Cthugua.

Send a Synchro Monster and an Xyz Monster you control to the GY to Contact Fuse Elder Entity N'tss without Polymerization; if Nyarla had Old Entity Hastorr or another N'tss attached from the GY, their GY effects trigger simultaneously.

summary.title: Entity Tri-Type Synergy
summary.text: The Entity Extra Deck monsters reward combining Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Monsters. Old Entity Cthugua draws 1 card when used as Fusion or Xyz Material. Outer Entity Nyarla detaches all its materials to attach any monster from your GY (such as Elder Entity N'tss or Old Entity Hastorr) as Xyz Material; when Nyarla is sent to the GY (for instance, to Contact Summon Elder Entity N'tss), its attached N'tss destroys a card on the field or its attached Hastorr equips to an opponent's monster to negate its effects and later steal control of it.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Elder Entity N'tss Special Summons a Level 4 monster from your hand once per turn and destroys 1 card on the field whenever it is sent to the GY.

Old Entity Hastorr equips itself to an opponent's monster from the GY to negate its effects and block its attacks, then permanently takes control of that monster if Hastorr leaves the Spell & Trap Zone.
Super Polymerization fuses opposing monsters into Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura, Wings of Resonant Life at Quick-Play speed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Forbidden Trapezohedron checks if you control exactly two of Fusion, Synchro, and Xyz Monsters and Special Summons the missing Entity category from the Extra Deck (Outer Entity Nyarla, Elder Entity N'tss, or an Old Entity Synchro).

Dreamland grants cumulative effects based on the Extra Deck monster types on the field: drawing 1 card when a monster hits the GY (Fusion), raising a monster's Level by 1 on summon (Synchro), and destroying the highest-Level monster during the End Phase (Xyz).
Forbidden Apocrypha declares Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz when 2 or more monsters of that type are on the field, forcing both players to send all monsters of that type they control to the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Elder Entity Norden and Outer Entity Azathot are Forbidden in the TCG and omitted from the Extra Deck.

main: Deep Sea Diva
One-card Level 4 Synchro starter that summons Duonigis from the Deck to Synchro Summon Old Entity Hastorr or Old Entity Cthugua.
Guitar Gurnards Duonigis
Level 2 Sea Serpent target for Deep Sea Diva that banishes cards from the opponent's Deck and enables Level 4 Synchros.
Red Resonator
Level 2 Tuner that Special Summons a Level 2 or Level 4 monster from your hand on Normal Summon.
Assault Synchron
Special Summons itself from the hand as a Level 2 Tuner to immediately climb into a Level 4 Old Entity Synchro.
Photon Thrasher
Level 4 Special Summon extender that pairs with Level 4 monsters to Xyz Summon Rank 4 Outer Entity Nyarla.
Kagetokage
Special Summons itself when you Normal Summon a Level 4 monster to assemble Rank 4 Outer Entity Nyarla.
Forbidden Trapezohedron

Signature Entity Spell: if you control a Fusion + Synchro, summons Outer Entity Nyarla and attaches it; if Synchro + Xyz, summons Elder Entity N'tss; if Xyz + Fusion, summons Old Entity Hastorr or Cthugua!
Dreamland

Signature Entity Field Spell that applies bonus effects based on the monster card types on the field: draws 1 card if a monster is sent to GY (Fusion), increases a monster's Level by 1 on summon (Synchro), and destroys the highest-Level monster during the End Phase (Xyz).
Instant Fusion
Summons Mudragon of the Swamp directly from the Extra Deck (Limited to 1 in TCG) to make Outer Entity Nyarla or Old Entity Cthugua (which draws 1 card when used as material!).
Super Polymerization
Fuses monsters on either field into Mudragon of the Swamp or Garura as an unrespondable Quick-Play Spell.
Forbidden Apocrypha

Signature Entity Trap that declares 1 monster card type (Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz); if 2 or more monsters of that type are on the field, forces both players to send all monsters of that type they control to the GY.
extra: Level 4 Fusion (1 Synchro + 1 Xyz) summoned by Contact Fusion without Polymerization; Special Summons a Level 4 monster from hand once per turn and destroys 1 card on the field whenever it is sent to the GY.

Level 4 WIND Reptile Synchro that equips to an opponent's monster when sent from the Monster Zone to the GY to negate its effects and prevent it from attacking, then permanently steals control of that monster if Hastorr leaves the Spell & Trap Zone!
Level 4 FIRE Pyro Synchro that bounces all Rank 4 Xyz Monsters on the field on Synchro Summon, and lets you draw 1 card if a Fusion or Xyz Monster is summoned using Cthugua as material!

Rank 4 EARTH Fiend Xyz that discards cards on Xyz Summon to increase its Rank, and detaches all materials to attach 1 monster from your GY (like Old Entity Hastorr or Elder Entity N'tss!) to copy its Type/Attribute and trigger its GY effect when sent to the GY.
Level 4 Fusion summoned via Instant Fusion or Super Polymerization that grants targeting immunity and serves as Level 4 material for Nyarla.
Level 6 Fusion summoned via Super Polymerization that inflicts double battle damage and draws 1 card when sent to the GY.
